scope: Normative readiness across five packages; existing sources and traces, no new paid run.

searched.how: Read current architecture, guide, lineage and four plan sources.
Inspect authority boundaries and implementation mappings.
Read retained J2/J3 trace-read narratives and baseline verdicts; aggregate retained call costs without executing models.
Read local recorded issue references and dispositions, not a fresh remote inventory.
Reconcile retained lineage and prior-art investigation; not a fresh exhaustive literature search.

findings.claim: The normative guide distinguishes represented entities, mechanisms and write authority; model choice depends on the investigation and resources.
An installed judge rule always preserves the other person's choice.
The judge detects quantity-dependent language gaps generally; fixed 3-at-10 is insufficient evidence.
The declaration checker rejects malformed outputs in the historical baseline; that does not establish correctness of valid rules.
J2 delivered the test report and the judge then named its fuel blocker; this fixture does not establish general wrong-rule repair.

cost.not_applicable: No new simulator/evaluation run. Historical workload costs recorded per task in plan.cost_basis; audit-agent time/token billing was not collected, so this does not claim zero audit cost.
